conclusions: TWSE historical valuation replay is empirically source-ready for bounded research cohorts.
252/756/1260 windows are operationally computable when enough valid observations exist.
Different windows can produce materially different percentile ranks even for the same current valuation.
Fiscal denominator transitions and corporate-action legal-session boundaries are required context tags.
New-listing and PE-missing states correctly fail closed.
No return outcomes were joined and no alpha claim is made.

maturity.reason: Source/replay integrity strengthened, but L4 still requires prospective/OOS outcome evidence.
